He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]]. Adams was selected in the [[2006 NBA draft]] by the [[New Jersey Nets]] and played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) for two seasons with the Nets and [[Toronto Raptors]]. He also played overseas in Italy, Serbia, the Philippines, Venezuela and Singapore. ==High school career== Adams played at [[Phineas Banning High School]] in [[Wilmington, Los Angeles]], for his freshman season and [[Verbum Dei Jesuit High School]] in Los Angeles during his sophomore season.{{cite web |last1=Pucin |first1=Diane |title=Adams Can Find Support From a Variety of Sources |url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2005-dec-28-sp-pucin28-story.html |website=Los Angeles Times |access-date=September 7, 2023 |date=December 28, 2005}} Adams transferred to [[Westchester High School (Los Angeles)|Westchester High School]] in [[Westchester, California|Westchester]], Los Angeles, where he averaged 18 points, 5 rebounds and 3 assists while leading his team to a 32–2 record, the California State Division I-A Championship, and a USA Today No. 1 ranking in his senior year. A McDonald's All-American and second team Parade All-America pick. Named [[California Mr. Basketball]], the first guard to receive the honor since [[Baron Davis]] in 1997. ==Collegiate career== Adams played collegiately at the [[University of Arizona]] from 2002 to 2006. Adams played primarily at the [[small forward]] position under coach [[Lute Olson]] and wore number 21 throughout his collegiate career. He was named [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-10 First Team]] in 2006. ==Professional career== In the [[2006 NBA draft]], Adams was selected by the [[Brooklyn Nets|New Jersey Nets]] in the second round with the 54th pick. In pre-draft workouts, Adams was injured after [[University of Texas|Texas]] forward [[P. J. Tucker]] stepped on his foot.{{Cite web |date=2006-06-28 |title=2006 Draft Profile: P.J. Tucker |url=https://www.espn.com/blog/truehoop/post/_/id/1876/2006-draft-profile-p-j-tucker |access-date=2022-12-14 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Adams made the Nets roster and in his rookie year and started eight games, finishing with 61 played games that season. He scored his first points on November 24. On November 29, 2006, Adams scored a career-high 16 points against the [[Boston Celtics]] in 23 minutes of playing time. On July 14, 2007, the Nets waived Adams.[http://www.nba.com/nets/news/NETS_WAIVE_HASSAN_ADAMS.html NETS WAIVE HASSAN ADAMS] Adams worked out with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] and played in three preseason games for the Cavs, averaging 2.7 ppg, 0.7 rpg and 0.3 apg in 6.3 mpg. On October 27, 2007, the Cavs waived him.{{cite news | url = http://realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/48801/20071027/cleveland_waives_adams_and_rice/ | title = Cleveland Waives Adams And Rice | publisher = [RealGM Staff Report] | date = October 27, 2007 | access-date = October 27, 2007 | url-status = dead | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20071028100434/http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/48801/20071027/cleveland_waives_adams_and_rice/ | archive-date = October 28, 2007 }} On July 1, 2008, Adams signed a two-year contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]] after attending the team's free-agent camp.{{cite news| url = http://www.nba.com/raptors/news/hassan_070808.html | title = Raptors Sign Free Agent Hassan Adams | publisher = [[Toronto Raptors]] | date = July 8, 2008 | access-date = July 8, 2008}} On January 7, 2009, Adams was traded to the Los Angeles Clippers along with cash considerations for a future conditional second-round pick.{{cite web| url = http://www.nba.com/clippers/news/hadams_090107.html | title = Clippers Acquire Hassan Adams From Toronto Raptors | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = January 7, 2009 | access-date = January 7, 2009 }} He was quickly waived by the Clippers,{{cite web| url = http://www.nba.com/clippers/news/hadams_waived_090107.html | title = Clippers Waive Hassan Adams | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = January 7, 2009 | access-date = January 7, 2009 }} and signed with [[KK Vojvodina Srbijagas]] shortly after.[http://www.sportando.com/en/cups/adriatic-league/75336/vojvodina-srbijagas-inks-hassan-adams.html Vojvodina Srbijagas inks Hassan Adams] In 2011, Adams played in the [[Philippine Basketball Association]] as an import for the [[Rain or Shine Elasto Painters]] during the [[2011 PBA Commissioner's Cup]]. In July 2014, he signed with the [[Singapore Slingers]] for the [[2014 ABL season]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/127614/singapore-slingers-sign-hassan-adams.html Singapore Slingers sign
